generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of Man Power Service works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing Man Power Service work

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act
Further particulars if any required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer PWD Sedam Division during office hours on all working days Sedam
GST of 18% shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for the delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

The contractor who participates in tenders for more than one work for which tenders are invited in this IFT, the tenderer must fulfill all the conditions and criteria cumulatively for the participated works

The tenderer shall furnish last five years financial turnover, profit and loss account statement i.e., from 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 from the authorized Auditor or C.A. (Achieved in at least Two financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of Man Power Serivce works only) (usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this conctract)

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e, from 2021-22, 2022-23,2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (b) Satisfactorily completed, as prime contractor, at least One Similar Nature of work of value not less than 50% of work on amount put to tender attach certificate by not below rank of Executive Engineer with Indent No. from Portal
Photo copy of the work before commencement of the work, during the work and after completion of the work should be produce with the bill

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in the form of DD/FDR in the name of the Executive Engineer, PWD sedam Division, sedam given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with the Conditions of Contract

Assessed available tender capacity AxNx2.50 - B where A Maximum value of Man Power Service works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited. B Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed. The tenderer has to Assess.
The work should be Maintenance upto 31-03-2027 (including Mansoon)
EMD of Rs. 46,500/- is to be paid in full through e-payment
